item.title: BBC Front Page: Three men guilty of 'callous' Brighton beach rape
item.description: The men, who are all asylum seekers, had denied targeting the woman in the early hours of October 4.

item.title: BBC World: Two trains collide head-on in Denmark, leaving five critically hurt
item.description: The accident happened early on Thursday at a level crossing north of Copenhagen.

item.title: BBC World: MrBeast's company sued by ex-employee over sexual harassment claim
item.description: Beast Industries has strongly denied claims of sexual harassment and workplace gender bias.

item.title: BBC World: Trump administration reclassifies cannabis as less dangerous
item.description: Medical marijuana was moved into a lower category of drugs in order to increase research and access.

item.title: BBC Front Page: Sara Cox replaces Scott Mills on Radio 2 breakfast show
item.description: The 51-year-old, who is originally from Bolton, currently presents the teatime show on Radio 2.

item.title: ABC Business: Tanzania postelection inquiry shows 518 people died in last year’s violence
item.description: A commission in Tanzania formed to investigate postelection violence says that at least 518 people died after the October vote

item.title: ABC Business: Trump threats against Iran are a boon for prediction markets, including some backed by his son
item.description: President Donald Trump loves to keep people guessing about his next policy moves, a reality TV, cliffhanger governing style that is helping “events” wagering companies, including some backed by one of his sons

item.title: ABC Business: Trump reclassifies state-licensed medical marijuana as a less-dangerous drug in a historic shift
item.description: President Donald Trump’s acting attorney general has signed an order reclassifying state-licensed medical marijuana as a less-dangerous drug

item.title: ABC Business: US jobless claim filings rise modestly to 214,000 last week, remain at healthy levels
item.description: The number of Americans filing for unemployment benefits inched up last week but remains within the historically healthy range of recent years

item.title: ABC Business: US military says it seizes another oil tanker associated with Iran
item.description: The U.S. military has seized another tanker associated with the smuggling of Iranian oil

item.title: BBC Front Page: Health data of 500,000 people offered for sale online in China after UK Biobank breach
item.description: The government said medical data was affected but no personally identifiable information had been made available.

item.title: BBC World: In Tehran, money is short and a return to war looms over daily life
item.description: The BBC's Lyse Doucet reports from Iran, where the buzz of busy shopping streets masks deep uncertainty over the country's future.

item.title: BBC Front Page: Riot police to deploy on French beaches under new deal to stop illegal Channel migrant crossings
item.description: The three-year agreement will see at least 50 riot-trained police officers drafted in to tackle violence and “hostile crowds”.

item.title: BBC World: South African court orders Zambia to return former president's body
item.description: Zambia authorities and Edgar Lungu's family are in a dispute over where the former leader's remains should be buried.

item.title: ABC Business: Stocks retreat and oil tops $100 despite fresh records on Wall St
item.description: Shares have retreated in Europe and Asia while Brent crude topped $100 a barrel as investors reacted to shaky prospects for more talks on ending the war with Iran

item.title: ABC Business: Russian oil to Slovakia resumes flowing through pipeline that crosses Ukraine
item.description: Slovakia's economy minister says the flow of Russian oil to Slovakia through the Druzhba pipeline that crosses Ukraine has resumed

item.title: BBC World: US Navy chief leaving post 'effective immediately', Pentagon says
item.description: Reports say Phelan, whose role was largely administrative, left amid tension over US shipbuilding.

item.title: ABC Business: A look at China's behind-the-scenes role in Iran war diplomacy
item.description: China's behind-the-scenes role in efforts to de-escalate the Iran conflict has been gaining attention

item.title: ABC Business: New York Times says FBI investigated reporter after article about director Kash Patel's girlfriend
item.description: The New York Times says it has learned that the FBI investigated one of its reporters, Elizabeth Williamson, after she wrote about its agents being assigned to protect and transport the girlfriend of that agency's director, Kash Patel
